required_assessment_cardinality: exactly one explicit actor-authored assessment per required condition per selected-function/basis snapshot; distinct run-A and run-B sets retain their own seven assessments and are not one fourteen-assessment set
declaration_order: This file and conditions.json must be frozen and hashed before observations; assessments and path_state follow review of those observations.

owner.scope: Pure state combination only, after independent complete-condition/cardinality and basis review; not the full A1 package validator.

material_scope_limitations: Seeded roles, sequential requests, local SQLite and Chromium

relation_owner.limits: Pure normalized-relation calculation only; it does not discover current revisions, traverse the graph, judge a new result or write relations.

basis_change_plan.unchanged_control: The same legal dependency with an unchanged target revision remains current.
basis_change_plan.history: Keep old observations, assessments and path result; read a second real run before authoring new assessment revisions.
basis_change_plan.separate_business_revision: Expense business revision 1→2 exercises the application; platform execution/evidence basis revision change is a separate proof.

composition_rule: function_condition_composition.v0.2: first establish complete required-set/cardinality and bound judgments independently; call the original owner precedence calculation; all valid assessments with retained material scope limitations yield scope_limited. The calculation is not itself a judgment.
